news.title: Apple says UK App Store proposal amounts to price regulation
news.summary: LONDON, July 29 (Reuters) - Apple said on Wednesday that proposed UK rules governing its App Store would amount to price regulation, arguing that plans to loosen ‌its control over in-app payments could undermine innovation and investment. In a submission to Britain's ‌Competition and Markets Authority, the iPhone maker said proposed "steering" requirements would go beyond promoting competition and give the regulator a "highly ​intrusive" role in managing its business.
